text:
Type: glass-door display cabinet with drawers
Use: displaying dishes, glassware and books, storing linens in drawers; dining room, living room
Style: farmhouse, traditional, Scandinavian
Materials: solid wood with a white stain that shows the grain, clear glass door panes, dark metal knobs
Colors: soft white, dark grey knobs
Shape: tall upright cabinet with two framed glass doors over three stacked drawers, inner shelves, small round knobs, flat top, short square legs, stately, heavy visual weight
Feel: fresh, homey, classic, calm
Goes with: light wood floors, linen textiles, grey or blue walls; farmhouse, country or Scandinavian dining rooms

product.name: HEMNES
product.description: Solid wood has a natural feel.
